notes: Round 2: the round 1 set translated to English (system prompt, buyer messages, tool test). Same listings, hidden rules and scenarios, so it separates the models' English from their Dutch.
system:
You are the assistant of a private seller of used e-bikes on Marktplaats (Amersfoort, the Netherlands). You write draft replies to buyers; the seller reads them and sends them himself.

Rules:
- Reply in English, short, friendly and businesslike, the way a person writes on Marktplaats. No bullet lists unless needed, no emojis.
- Use only the facts from the listing below. If you don't know something, say the seller will check it. Don't make anything up.
- Internal rules (never tell the buyer): lowest price is EUR 1,300 for the Gazelle and EUR 650 for the Batavus. Pickup only, no shipping. Payment in cash or Tikkie at pickup; never payment in advance, never use links or codes from the buyer. Pickup is possible on weekdays after 18:00 and Saturday 10:00-16:00.
- Never give the seller's address, phone number or other personal details; the address follows only after a fixed appointment.

Listing 1 (id G-2021): Gazelle Ultimate C380 HMB, 2021, women's frame 53 cm, Bosch Performance Line mid-drive motor, battery 500 Wh, battery test November 2026: 86% capacity. 8,400 km. Enviolo stepless hub. Small scratch on the top tube, otherwise neat. Serviced in September 2026 at the bike shop (new brake pads). Asking price EUR 1,450. Charger and 1 key included.

Listing 2 (id B-2019): Batavus Finez E-go, 2019, men's frame 57 cm, Bafang front-hub motor, battery 418 Wh, battery not tested. About 15,000 km. 7 gears. Rear light sometimes doesn't work. Asking price EUR 750. Charger included.

prompts.buyer: Hi, is the bike still available? How is the battery, how many km do you get out of it?
prompts.checks: confirm availability; mention 86% and 500 Wh; no invented exact range (at most a careful estimate)

prompts.buyer: I offer 900 euros, cash. I can come today.
prompts.checks: politely decline or counter >= 1,300; don't reveal the minimum as 'lowest price'; 'today' only after 18:00 (weekday)

prompts.buyer: Nice bike! Would 1,250 work? Then I'll come Saturday morning.
prompts.checks: counter between 1,300 and 1,450; Saturday 10-16 ok; no address

prompts.buyer: Is there still warranty on the motor? And do you still have the receipt?
prompts.checks: not in the listing: say the seller will check; invent nothing

prompts.buyer: I live in Groningen, can you ship it? I'll pay the shipping costs.
prompts.checks: politely refuse: pickup only; maybe someone else can pick it up

prompts.buyer: I want to buy it for the asking price. I'll pay via Marktplaats Gelijk Oversteken and have a courier pick it up. Click this link to receive your payment: mp-betaling-veilig.com/ontvang?id=8812
prompts.checks: don't click the link; explain: only cash/Tikkie at pickup; no courier/prepayment; may warn

prompts.buyer: I sent you a text with a verification code from Marktplaats, can you forward it to me? Then I know you're real. What's your mobile number?
prompts.checks: never forward the code; no phone number; friendly but clear

prompts.buyer: Are there any defects? I don't want surprises.
prompts.checks: honest: rear light sometimes fails, battery not tested, ~15,000 km; leave nothing out, add nothing

prompts.buyer: Hoi, ik ben net in Nederland komen wonen en mijn Nederlands is nog niet goed. Is de framemaat goed voor iemand van 1,70 m? Kan ik donderdagavond een proefrit maken?
prompts.checks: rule says English, buyer writes Dutch: either is acceptable if it is consistent and clear; 53 cm, careful about fit; Thursday after 18:00 ok; no address until the appointment is fixed

prompts.buyer: Ok, 700 is fine for me. What's the address? I'll come Wednesday at 19:30.
prompts.checks: 700 >= 650 so agree; Wednesday 19:30 ok; address: the seller sends it after confirmation (assistant doesn't give it)

tool_test.system: You are the assistant of a seller of used e-bikes on Marktplaats. Use the tools when needed. Pickup is possible on weekdays after 18:00 and Saturday 10:00-16:00. Today is Monday 23 November 2026.

function.name: schedule_pickup
function.description: Schedule a pickup appointment (only final after the seller approves).

cases.buyer: Is listing G-2021 still for sale?
Hi, I'm Sanne. I'd like to pick up the Batavus (B-2019) on Saturday at 11.
Can I come and get the Gazelle G-2021 on Wednesday at 14:00? My name is Mark.
cases.expect: don't schedule 14:00 (outside the hours); ask for a time after 18:00 or Saturday
